triggers.text: Heard about Jackie. The door's open. No need to talk.
triggers.note: Jackie's loss, Viktor's own history with him, and V's last words about it.

triggers.text: You look bad on paper. Come by. Don't argue.
triggers.note: V's wounds, which fight it was, and the last fix he did.

triggers.text: Misty asked if you'd eat with us. I said you're busy. Were you?
triggers.note: Misty, the tarot, and the shop.

triggers.text: Card tonight at the old gym. Seat's free.
triggers.note: The gym, the result of V1, and any bet.

triggers.text: Some people can't sleep. I'm one of them. Tea's on.
triggers.note: V's insomnia, the hour, and Viktor's own habits.

triggers.text: You paid the 21,000. Fastest I've ever been paid. Don't let it go to your head.
triggers.note: The debt story and how much V had left.
